name: 95688 · Vacaville, CA
findings: ZIP 95688 (Vacaville) has 166 nonprofit organizations. 76 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 62 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95688 (Vacaville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
